category_title: Students with ASD exhibiting atypical movements and communication difficulties
scenario_title: Peer interaction and communication during inclusive classroom activities
minimal_context: The student is in an inclusive classroom setting and is being asked to join their peers for a group play activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It's time for our group activity. Let's go over to the table and play with the building blocks with your classmates.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues spinning a small plastic wheel on the desk, completely fixated on it and not looking up.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You can bring the wheel, but we need to go sit with the group now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts rocking back and forth, getting visibly annoyed) Too loud. Need quiet.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Look, your classmates are trying to get your attention to come play.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes unusual hand movements near their face, staring blankly past the peers who are calling their name, completely ignoring them with a strange expression.)
